articles.title: New AI tech cuts energy use up to 50% and boost...
articles.description: Trust Carbon Infrastructure unveiled its HXS compute-efficiency layer, which reduces energy consumption by up to 50.5% and increases server throughput by 167% on NVIDIA H100 GPUs without changing AI model outputs. Tested on models from Alibaba, Meta, Google, and Microsoft, HXS lowers operating temperatures and energy costs, enabling more efficient AI serving on existing hardware. The technology is being offered to partners for exclusive licensing or acquisition and can be validated on users' own workloads.
